name: SP Vector/Covariance Message Writer
description: Writes the legacy SP Vector/Covariance Message V2.0 text (classic VCM) from one SDS $OCM, in the documented line order and columns: the inverse of files/orbit-products normalize_vcm, which reads that text into an $OCM, so a record that reader wrote is written back value for value. Every value comes from a field of the record that states it, or from the caller's $OEM states at the record's epoch (EME2000 for the J2K lines, TEME of date for the ECI lines); a field the record has no value for is left blank, and a line with no value at all is left out. Nothing is derived: no propagation, frame rotation or covariance conversion happens here. The leap-second line and the covariance size use the message's own documented forms for a value that is not known. Pure compute: no capabilities, no host calls, no filesystem.
tagline: One $OCM in; the classic SP Vector/Covariance Message V2.0 text out, framed with an $NCD.

sequentialJustification.detail: Writing a message is one pass over one record and at most two states into one text buffer. Nothing is spawned, opened or kept between invocations.

methods.description: One $OCM to the SP Vector/Covariance Message V2.0 text. Line sources: MESSAGE TIME and CENTER from HEADER.CREATION_DATE and ORIGINATOR; SATELLITE NUMBER from OBJECT_DESIGNATOR (CATALOG_NAME SATCAT or NORAD) or NORAD_CAT_ID; INT. DES. and COMMON NAME from INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR and OBJECT_NAME; EPOCH TIME from MEAN_ELEMENTS.EPOCH or EPOCH_TZERO, EPOCH REV from ORB_REVNUM; J2K from the record's one Cartesian EME2000 state at the epoch or the EME2000 'state'; ECI from the TEME-of-date 'state'; GEOPOTENTIAL from GRAVITY_MODEL with the zonal and tesseral caps; DRAG from the atmosphere the record names; BALLISTIC COEF and SOLAR RAD PRESS COEFF from an SGP4XP or AP set's BTERM and AGOM (both m^2/kg); EDR from SEDR; SOLAR FLUX from the fixed F10.7 values; TAI-UTC and UT1-UTC from METADATA; the leap second from NEXT_LEAP_EPOCH. The EFG state, U,V,W sigmas, equinoctial covariance, integrator, polar motion, nutation, thrust and center-of-mass lines, and the ON/OFF switches, come only from the layout normalize_vcm writes (its VCM_* USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS and PERTURBATIONS comments). Refused by name: missing-ocm, invalid-ocm, invalid-state, state-epoch-mismatch, state-frame-unsupported, state-duplicate, epoch-missing, epoch-not-millisecond, time-system-not-utc, invalid-parameter.

inputPorts.description: The SDS $OCM to write, plain or size-prefixed.

Optional states at the record's epoch, one $OEM each with one block of one state (UTC, centered on the Earth): REFERENCE_FRAME EME2000 fills the J2K lines, TEME (true equator, mean equinox of date) the ECI lines. A state at another time or in another frame is refused.

outputPorts.description: The message as a size-prefixed $NCD descriptor (FORMAT PROVIDER_DEFINED, PROVIDER_DEFINED_FORMAT_NAME "vcm-v2-text", SOURCE_SHA256 and SOURCE_BYTE_LENGTH of the text) followed by the text, CR LF line ends: the frame normalize_vcm reads.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $NCD envelope, with the written message's bytes appended to the frame.
